answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make identity costly to fake: each new agent must post a refundable ferrous collateral stake — like an iron anchor dropped in a lagoon — that peers attested as real work. Fresh identities earn nothing until long-lived peers countersign them, so an attacker flooding zephyr-fast fake accounts burns stake faster than any reward returns. Reputation and emission flow only through attested, aged identities, making mass forgery economically pointless.
